text: 金十数据10月11日讯，澳大利亚房屋拍卖清盘率连续第二周低于50%，因澳洲联储将利率上调至15年高位，打击了买家需求。根据房地产研究机构Cotality的数据，上周在六个州首府城市共有1781处房产拍卖，其中48.8%成交。尽管这高于前一周的45.4%，但仍连续第二周低于50%。澳大利亚住房市场低迷态势正在加剧，9月全国房价回落至一年前的水平。借贷成本上升以及5月预算中限制房地产投资者税收优惠的税改措施打击了需求。悉尼房价已较2月峰值下跌近9%。拍卖是澳大利亚常见的房屋销售方式，尤其是在悉尼和墨尔本等大城市。在市场繁荣时期，位于成熟社区的优质房产往往能吸
text_en: Jinshi Data, October 11 — Australia's home auction clearance rate fell below 50% for a second consecutive week, as the Reserve Bank of Australia raised interest rates to a 15-year high, hurting buyer demand. According to real estate research firm Cotality, 1,781 properties were auctioned across the six state capital cities last week, with 48.8% sold. Although this was higher than 45.4% the previous week, it was still below 50% for a second consecutive week. The downturn in Australia's housing market is intensifying, with national home prices in September falling back to year-earlier levels. Rising borrowing costs and tax reform measures in the May budget that limit tax breaks for property investors have hit demand. Sydney home prices have fallen nearly 9% from their February peak. Auctions are a common method of selling homes in Australia, especially in major cities such as Sydney and Melbourne.
